u0: The agent has not reached the exit and has not yet carried the box on any step. The mandatory objective is simply to reach the exit; arriving there ends the episode successfully even if the optional carrying aim was not met. If a box is available, carrying it on two separate steps would fulfill the optional aim, and the first carrying step starts that progress.
u1: The agent has carried the box on exactly one step so far and has not yet reached the exit. Reaching the exit remains the mandatory objective and completes the task even without the optional aim. One more distinct step of carrying the box is needed to fulfill that optional aim; if the box is still held, continuing to carry it into another step works, and if it was dropped or fell, it can be picked up and carried again.
u2: The agent has reached the exit, so the mandatory objective is complete and the episode ends successfully. The optional aim of carrying the box on at least two distinct steps may or may not have been fulfilled on the way, but no further objectives remain.
u3: The box has already been carried on at least two distinct steps, so the optional carrying aim is satisfied. The only remaining objective is to reach the exit, which ends the episode successfully; no further carrying is required and this progress cannot be lost.
